channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about LaVar Ball | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about LaVar Ball from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Magic Johnson on LaVar Ball
item.description:
Magic Johnson:

“I would've called you first before I called LaVar Ball. Trust me.”

Magic Johnson on LaVar Ball, Jul 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: Larry Nance Jr on Luke Walton, LaVar Ball
item.description:
Larry Nance Jr. on LaVar Ball’s negative comments about Luke Walton and whether they discuss it as a team:

“I mean, every now and again [we talk about it], but it’s more so just in passing. It’s not like we’re ever sitting around like, ‘What are we going to do about this?!’ No. He’s a grown man and he can say what he wants. Luke is a grown man and he can deal with it. We’re all grown men, individually. As players, it’s not necessarily our job to deal with it, worry about it or even think about it. We pretty much leave it alone. Of course we all see it, but he’s got the right to an opinion just like everybody else does.”

Larry Nance Jr on Luke Walton, LaVar Ball, Jan 27, 2018. Source: audioBoom.

item.title: Luke Walton on LaVar Ball
item.description:
Walton said of Lakers management.

“Whatever those meetings [with LaVar Ball in the past] are, I'm not concerned with those. My concerns are coaching our team and prepping for games and working with what gives us the best chance of winning. I know our front office and organization. They'll do whatever they have to do on their end of it, but I'm not spending my time trying to figure out what they're all doing about it. I just know they'll take care of it.”

Luke Walton on LaVar Ball, Jan 8, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Rick Carlisle, LaVar Ball
item.description:
“I don't see it because I don't look at it. I heard about it. Everybody's heard about it. To be honest with you, one word (about Ball's comments) is too many. I'm glad (Carlisle) did what he did, he represented the coaches. Luke does a great job in Los Angeles.”

Mike D'Antoni on Rick Carlisle, LaVar Ball, Jan 8, 2018. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on LaVar Ball
item.description:
Steve Popper:Carlisle on ESPN and Lavar Ball:

“They should look at their sources and do a better job of determining whether they have any merit or any validity or are they just blowhard loudmouths. That’s what I’m saying.”

Rick Carlisle on LaVar Ball, Jan 7, 2018. Source: Twitter @StevePopper.

item.title: Ric Flair on LaVar Ball
item.description:
Ric Flair:

“Are you gonna bring up LaVar Ball? … That's too easy, man … Lot of ammunition there, huh? He told Stephen A. (Smith), 'I'm undefeated.' That's only because he hasn't run into me. He wouldn't even say that to me.”

Ric Flair on LaVar Ball, May 23, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Stephon Marbury on LaVar Ball
item.description:
If LaVar Ball, father of NBA prospect Lonzo Ball, hopes to get his Big Baller Brand going without the help of the major shoe companies, Marbury could offer some advice.

“I would listen to what [LaVar Ball] had to say, definitely, if he called,”

Stephon Marbury on LaVar Ball, May 3, 2017. Source: The Undefeated.
